title: Fraudulent UPI requests and fake QR codes - support procedure
content: The synthetic workflow marks the report high risk and prepares a human handoff with the payment channel and masked description. Reject suspicious requests and contact verified bank support for any real debit; the assistant never requests your UPI PIN.
